turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know why my son's grade changed on a phone in the middle of class before anyone called me.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
I didn't agree to anything, Hale. You asked, and I'd have come anyway. Who decided on the zero?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
Don't manage me. You looked me up before you called me about my son's grade. Who decided on the zero?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
Then show me the evidence, Hale. So far all I've heard is flattery, and I haven't heard what you're following.
